title: The Umbrella Academy
tagline: Too many siblings. Not enough timeline.
synopsis: Reunited by their father's death, estranged siblings with extraordinary powers uncover shocking family secrets — and a looming threat to humanity.

episodes.title: We Only See Each Other at Weddings and Funerals
episodes.synopsis: Years after they rose to fame as young crime-fighting superheroes, the estranged Hargreeves siblings come together to mark their father's death.

episodes.title: Run Boy Run
episodes.synopsis: After sharing the story of his time travel with Vanya, Five hunts for the owner of a fake eye. But two mysterious assassins are hot on his trail.

episodes.title: Extra Ordinary
episodes.synopsis: Worried their mother is hiding something, Luther and Allison call a family meeting. Cha-Cha and Hazel catch a big break in their hunt for Five.

episodes.title: Man on the Moon
episodes.synopsis: The story of Luther's transformation emerges. At the motel, Klaus puts Hazel and Cha-Cha's training to the test. Allison grows suspicious of Leonard.

episodes.title: Number Five
episodes.synopsis: Five lets Luther in on his secret, Klaus returns from a harrowing trip through time, and Vanya begins to feel different without her meds.

episodes.title: The Day That Wasn't
episodes.synopsis: Sparks fly when Vanya finds her siblings holding an emergency family meeting without her. Five starts his new job at HQ. Cha-Cha faces a dilemma.

episodes.title: The Day That Was
episodes.synopsis: With a second chance at the day, the siblings team up to find the mysterious "Harold Jenkins." Leonard takes Vanya into the woods to test her powers.

episodes.title: I Heard a Rumor
episodes.synopsis: As Vanya practices controlling her new abilities, Allison tags along with a local cop to find out what happened outside the restaurant.

episodes.title: Changes
episodes.synopsis: Vanya veers between shock and despair as she makes a string of unsettling discoveries. A serendipitous development leaves Five at loose ends.

episodes.title: The White Violin
episodes.synopsis: As a lifetime of secrets and resentment bring the Umbrella Academy crashing down, the Hargreeves siblings realize the worst is still to come.

episodes.title: Right Back Where We Started
episodes.synopsis: After dropping his siblings into an alley in Dallas — in different years — Five scrambles to track them all down and stop a new doomsday threat.

episodes.title: The Frankel Footage
episodes.synopsis: An incident at the bar leads Luther to Vanya. Five finds an unsettling surprise in the film Hazel left behind. The cops come after Allison's husband.

episodes.title: The Swedish Job
episodes.synopsis: As the sit-in approaches, Allison reconnects with Klaus, the Swedes chase Vanya into a cornfield, and Luther makes a distressing discovery.

episodes.title: The Majestic 12
episodes.synopsis: While Allison searches frantically for Ray, Vanya contends with a crisis at the farm, and Five, Diego, and Lila crash a party at the Mexican Consulate.

episodes.title: Valhalla
episodes.synopsis: Summoned to an emergency meeting, the siblings hatch very different plans for how to spend their last six days on Earth. Lila confronts her mother.

episodes.title: A Light Supper
episodes.synopsis: Allison gives Ray a peek at her powers, Dave visits Klaus's compound, the Handler offers Five a deal, and the siblings meet their father for dinner.

episodes.title: Öga for Öga
episodes.synopsis: After Five travels to 1982 to carry out his new mission, the siblings face a flurry of difficult decisions. Carl issues a warning to Vanya.

episodes.title: The Seven Stages
episodes.synopsis: A desperate Five concocts a risky plan to intercept another version of himself. The FBI tortures Vanya. Diego discovers what causes the apocalypse.
As the Fives plot against each other, one of the siblings makes a big sacrifice to help Vanya, and Lila learns the truth about her parents.

episodes.title: The End of Something
episodes.synopsis: Reeling from the events at Dealey Plaza, the siblings head to the farm to help save Harlan — only to find themselves drawn into a deadly showdown.

episodes.title: Meet the Family
episodes.synopsis: After averting a doomsday in Dallas, the Umbrella siblings return to a very different Academy — now ruled by the powerful and hostile Sparrows.

episodes.title: World's Biggest Ball of Twine
episodes.synopsis: With their Number One missing, the Sparrows take a hostage. Allison makes a painful discovery. Klaus takes Five on an eye-opening road trip.

episodes.title: Pocket Full of Lightning
episodes.synopsis: As people start disappearing in waves, Five and Lila reluctantly team up to solve their time-travel problem. Klaus sees a new side of his father.

episodes.title: Kugelblitz
episodes.synopsis: Luther and Sloane hatch a plan to end the war between the families. Viktor reconnects with someone from the past. Five has an unsettling encounter.

episodes.title: Kindest Cut
episodes.synopsis: Klaus's relationship with death proves more complicated than anyone knew. Viktor finally learns what happened to the Umbrellas' mothers.

episodes.title: Marigold
episodes.synopsis: Five chases down Pogo, Viktor and Harlan attempt a transfer of powers, and Diego and Lila venture beyond the wall of the White Buffalo Suite.

episodes.title: Auf Wiedersehen
episodes.synopsis: In 1989, Lila digs up one of her mother's secrets. The families join forces to fight the Kugelblitz. Reginald teaches Klaus to harness his powers.

episodes.title: Wedding at the End of the World
episodes.synopsis: With the universe collapsing around them, the gang gathers for a day of romance, awkwardness and debauchery at the Hotel Obsidian.

episodes.title: Seven Bells
episodes.synopsis: Reginald goes all out to convince the children to sign on to his plan. Five tries to recover a drunken memory. Allison has a change of heart.

episodes.title: Oblivion
episodes.synopsis: Shaken, the family confronts the deadly mysteries of the Hotel Oblivion — and the growing suspicion that their mission is not what it seems.

episodes.title: The Unbearable Tragedy of Getting What You Want
episodes.synopsis: The family teams up to find a kidnapped Viktor while attempting to adjust to normal life. Lila and Five probe a mysterious group called the Keepers.

episodes.title: Jean and Gene
episodes.synopsis: With their powers restored, the gang embarks on a mission to find Sy Grossman's daughter. But they soon encounter hostility in a seemingly quaint town.

episodes.title: The Squid and the Girl
episodes.synopsis: The group splits up to find Jennifer. Later on, they pay Reginald a visit, confronting memories that hold critical clues to their mission.

episodes.title: The Cleanse
episodes.synopsis: After learning the truth about Jennifer, the crew sets out to find her and Ben. Klaus hustles to escape his plight. Five and Lila try to change the past.

episodes.title: Six Years, Five Months, and Two Days
episodes.synopsis: Lila and Five get lost traversing various timelines. Meanwhile, Viktor and Reginald aim to stop Ben, whose union with Jennifer sets forth a lethal path.

episodes.title: End of the Beginning
episodes.synopsis: With Ben and Jennifer in peril and the Cleanse underway, the family unites for one last fight to save the world — and end the infinite devastation.
